transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um, hi. I guess... well, for the past few weeks, my eating has just been a bit off. I'll, uh, skip breakfast and lunch without really meaning to. And then I just kind of pick at dinner... even when my wife cooks. My jeans are starting to feel loose, so... yeah. I guess that's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah... I guess so. Most days lately, I just wake up with this... I don't know, this kind of heavy, flat feeling. Like the apartment is just too quiet. And, uh... I usually play guitar, but... even picking that up doesn't really lift me right now. So... yeah.
Have you noticed feeling more tired or lacking energy, even when you’re not doing much? Like even small tasks feel harder than usual?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I'm any more tired than usual. I mean, I'm not doing much anyway, so... it's just the normal amount of tired, I guess. Small tasks are just... small tasks.
Have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past few weeks?
Yeah... I mean, I think I just said that. It's just... most days, yeah. I wake up and it's just that heavy feeling I mentioned. It's pretty much all day. Just flat.
Have you been feeling like you're not worth much or felt guilty about things more than usual lately?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think I feel guilty about anything. Just... kind of what I already said. But no.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety more often than not?

Um... not restless, no. Just... slower, maybe. Everything kind of feels slower right now. Like... I'll just sit there with my laptop open for ages before I even... try to move my hands to type. Or plug the keyboard in. It just... takes a while.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things, or is this the first time you've felt this way?
Um... I'm not really sure. I don't... I don't think I've felt exactly like this before. Or maybe I have, I just... I haven't really kept track. I don't know.
Would you say that your depressed mood occurs most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah... I guess most days. I just wake up with this... heavy kind of feeling. Everything's just flat. The apartment feels too quiet, and... I don't know, even if I pick up my guitar, it doesn't really lift me. So... yeah. Most of the day.
Have you noticed a decrease in your appetite or any significant weight loss recently?

I guess... yeah. My eating's been off for a few weeks. I don't really mean to, but I'll... skip breakfast and lunch. And then even when my wife cooks dinner, I just kind of pick at it. I don't really have an appetite. My jeans are... they're starting to feel loose. So, yeah. Weight loss, probably.
